objectives.description: Phase 1: Calibrate thresholds against real corpus data
Phase 2: Extract string-only gate checks into an importable module
Phase 3: Add printable-ratio and NUL/control-character checks
Phase 4: Widen page-coverage into a two-sided band
Phase 5: Unit-test fixtures for the new checks
Phase 7: Document the shared-module check pattern

approaches_tried.approach: broken-font-encoding PDF fixture using literal PUA characters via insert_text() under a base-14 font
approaches_tried.reason: PyMuPDF silently substitutes U+00B7 (middle dot) for un-representable glyphs under helv/hebo, so PUA chars never survive to extracted text

approaches_tried.approach: broken-font-encoding PDF fixture using literal low-range control characters (0x00-0x08) via insert_text()
approaches_tried.reason: survives intact through raw fitz get_text() (both dict-mode and the fallback tier), but pymupdf4llm.to_markdown() applies its own heuristic cleanup that alters/removes the raw control bytes on this specific synthetic construction -- used as the final fixture, asserted only against the fallback tier, with the primary-tier limitation documented

deviations.description: control_char_count(text) to count NUL plus every other Cc character excluding tab/newline/carriage-return
deviations.reason: Real-corpus calibration (Phase 1) found 19 of 38 measured documents legitimately use low-range Cc codepoints (up to 17299 occurrences) as a benign glyph-substitute convention for math symbols; blanket zero-tolerance would fail roughly half the existing corpus, violating the plan's own zero-false-positives goal.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- control_char_count() counts NUL only ... see calibration-notes.md)*

deviations.description: Measure page-coverage ratio distribution for a sample of at least 6 corpus documents with locatable source PDFs
deviations.reason: Only 2 of ~40 corpus documents had locatable/reconvertible source PDFs within the task's time budget (most metadata.json source_path values point at nonexistent ingest-time temp paths).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- only 2 of the ~40 corpus documents' source PDFs were locatable ...)*

deviations.description: broken-font-encoding fixture must fail the gate under pymupdf4llm, pymupdf, and auto converter modes (every tier)
deviations.reason: pymupdf4llm.to_markdown() applies its own heuristic character-substitution cleanup that sanitizes this specific insert_text()-constructed synthetic fixture before it reaches the gate. The fixture fails reliably on the fallback tier; the every-tier guarantee for genuine corruption is structural (single run_quality_gate() call site) and anchored by real already-ingested NUL evidence instead of this synthetic fixture on the primary tier.
